title: Python: CCP2 codecs and activation gate
description:
Implement the finalized wire.12 contract in python/src/lichen/rpl/tdma_beacon.py, python/src/lichen/announce/messages.py and the applicable dispatch in python/src/lichen/rpl/messages.py. Bind schedule, receiver and grant ownership to the specified root, DODAG, generation, plan and profile. Keep all version namespaces distinct. Unversioned, incompatible or malformed advertisements must not activate a CCP2 data schedule or partially mutate its state.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse existing codecs and signature interfaces. b7z9.74 identifies the shared signaling work but is not a dependency on an old roll-up; python.09 owns directional report publication after this generic codec boundary. Do not invent allocations, repurpose SCHC or signature-domain versions, weaken legacy tests, or edit audited OSCORE/EDHOC internals. No on-air activation is authorized by this task.
acceptance_criteria: Consume independently encoded and signed vectors.02 through production parsing, serialization and admission. Check exact bytes and signatures, every truncation boundary, duplicate and unknown fields, unsupported versions, invalid bounds, wrong root/DODAG/generation, activation and expiry, and unchanged state after rejection. Run python/tests/test_tdma_beacon_format.py, python/tests/rpl/test_ccp_beacon_sig_gate.py and python/tests/announce/test_messages.py with new revision-specific cases. Round trips alone are insufficient. Run scoped pytest, ruff and applicable configured typing.
